scientific_limitations: The assertion is restricted to four-coordinate Gabor frames over (Z/2Z)^2.
The seven-phase minimum concerns common finite root-of-unity alphabets; arbitrary complex windows are not subject to this minimum.
The theorem does not claim optimal singular-value conditioning, broader noncyclic-group classification, or absolute historical priority.
title: Universal four-atom dependencies and the sharp phase alphabet for Klein-group Gabor systems
